Sources and assumptions
Portfolio
CMF, BEST: investment tables by life insurer (Circular 1835), quarterly stock in CLP million, converted to USD at the Banco Central observed dollar of each quarter-end (USDCLP 744.6 in Dec-2019, 911.2 in Dec-2025, 922.3 in Jun-2026). Total market is the CMF aggregate. Offshore includes foreign fixed income, equities, funds, ETFs and structured notes.
Swaps
Note 8.2.8 “Swap contracts” of the annual financial statements (Confuturo: note 18 d of Inversiones Confuturo). Contract counts match each insurer’s note 8.2.2. Only cross currency swaps are counted; UF/CLP swaps and a few records with atypical notionals stay in the file but out of the totals.
Conversion to USD
The foreign-currency leg is converted at EURUSD 1.17 and GBPUSD 1.34. Offshore assets are converted at the observed dollar of the statement date (884.6 in Dec-2023, 992.1 in Dec-2024, 911.2 in Dec-2025). Swap notionals are approximations for comparing orders of magnitude.
Not included
Swaps of mid-size and small insurers (Security, Sura, 4Life and others), FX forwards, and the derivatives history since 2019. The counterparty rankings by trade year use only swaps still outstanding at the latest statements, so swaps traded in 2020–2022 that have already matured are missing and those years are understated. Those need the Circular 1835 B.7 file or earlier financial statements. MetLife only publishes its 2023 statements on its website.
